description: Test harness for server HTTP functions in the gateway module, including request creation, server setup, and route validation.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates a mock IncomingMessage with specified parameters for testing.

methods.name: createHookRequest
methods.description: Creates a mock IncomingMessage for hook requests with default authorization.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a mock ServerResponse with functions to capture response body and headers.

methods.name: dispatchRequest
methods.description: Emits a request event on the server and waits for it to be processed.

methods.name: withGatewayTempConfig
methods.description: Runs a function within a temporary gateway configuration context.

methods.name: createTestGatewayServer
methods.description: Creates a test instance of the Gateway HTTP server with specified auth and options.

methods.name: withGatewayServer
methods.description: Sets up a temporary server, runs tests, and cleans up.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request to the server and returns the response object.

methods.name: expectUnauthorizedResponse
methods.description: Asserts that the response has a 401 status and contains 'Unauthorized'.

methods.name: createCanonicalizedChannelPluginHandler
methods.description: Creates a mock handler for channel plugin route with canonical path validation.

methods.name: createHooksHandler
methods.description: Creates a hooks request handler with optional dispatch hooks and configuration.

methods.name: buildChannelPathFuzzCorpus
methods.description: Generates a list of route variants for fuzz testing channel paths.

methods.name: expectUnauthorizedVariants
methods.description: Checks multiple route variants for unauthorized responses.

methods.name: expectAuthorizedVariants
methods.description: Checks multiple route variants for authorized responses with correct route.

methods.name: defaultProtectedPluginRoutePath
methods.description: Checks if a path is a protected plugin route.
